user_story: As a screen-reader user, I want product images and login fields on https://www.saucedemo.com to carry accessible attributes so that assistive technology can describe them. Acceptance criteria: the login fields [data-test="username"] and [data-test="password"] each have a non-empty 'placeholder' attribute; after logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce', every product image inside '.inventory_item' ('img.inventory_item_img') has a non-empty 'alt' attribute.
